development_audit.qualification: In qbraid-algorithms 0.1.3 the generated program defines but does not call the supplied eigenstate preparation gate. Explicit-preparation variants add prep_eigenstate psi[0] immediately before qpe(q, psi); generated variants are unchanged. Three counting qubits and one eigenstate qubit were used. No automatic input repair is performed. PyQASM 1.3.0 rejected unrolling controlled T; compact T source was checked with the QuantumStudio adapter using pinned PyQASM 1.0.4.
